simple.whyItMatters: This word appears 3 times in the Hebrew Bible, so BibleIQ can compare how Scripture uses it across multiple passages.
simple.summary: כִּלְיוֹן (Kilyôwn) means Kiljon , an Israelite First listed occurrence: Ruth 1 2.

definitions.full: H3630. Kilyon כִּלְיוֺן proper name, masculine one of Naomi's sons Ruth 1:2 , 5 ; 4:9 , ᵐ5 Κελαιων , Ξελαιων , Ξελεων , ᵐ5 L Ξελλαιων (on etymology compare Jerome; see Lag Onom. ed. 2, 62, 5 ).
